markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (89%)** · Confident · Read in turn
InSitu is the sole conformal class [F1] (11% invasive risk), with unflagged tier-4 priority and drafted ER stain.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 89%, Invasive 11%, Normal/Benign <1% | Strong InSitu lead over Invasive |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 10% alpha (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% target |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Reliable input, atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (top-class consensus) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (81%–82% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous nearest-neighbor reference match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 3, 7) · context · Above-typical score (-0.83 contribution away from invasive) [F2]; 8/20 AI check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.66 contribution toward invasive) [F3]; 19/20 AI check · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.49 contribution) [F4], but unreliable (3/20 AI check) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4) · ↓ invasive · Restrains invasive score (-0.25 contribution; 20/20 AI check) · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction & pleomorphism** (regions 1, 4, 9) · context · 74% tumor cells (97th percentile) [F7], 93rd-percentile size CV [F9], 0% immune [F11] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); case leans on unreliable necrosis (3/20) and normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion in high-risk regions 0 (94%), 9 (86%), 1 (72%), or 4 (61%) is diluted by low-risk tiles.
- Invasive carcinoma (11% probability; similar to invasive case BACH_0134 at 76%) falls in the 10% conformal error rate.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4**: Check validated stromal infiltration and high invasive risk (72%, 61%) for basement-membrane breach.
2. **Regions 0, 9**: Inspect peak risk tiles (94%, 86%) and dense small pleomorphic nuclei (105 neoplastic in 9) [F8] [F10].
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 10, 11**: Verify duct confinement, weak TILs, and unreliable necrosis before confirming drafted ER stain.
